nodes.label: Fault F30.1 — foreign abandoned-branch artefacts found in rt/
Fault-before-result discipline
nodes.rationale: A fault is registered before any result touched by it is read, and the contents of quarantined artefacts are not read at all. Quarantine rather than deletion keeps adoption available as M's ruling; mtimes establish that the branch filed its prediction before its runs, so R 1449 was kept inside that branch.
